summary: Platform gateway other settings: JWT expiration buffer in seconds (default 2; raise it if latency between gateway and services causes 401 errors), status endpoint backend timeout and verify, and resource client request timeout.
questions: Why do I get 401 errors from controller through the gateway?
What is the JWT expiration buffer in AAP?
How do I fix intermittent 401 unauthorized in AAP 2.6?

answer_card.title: Fix intermittent 401s through the gateway
answer_card.answer_md: The gateway caches a JWT for each user and drops it from the cache a few seconds before it expires (**Jwt expiration buffer in seconds**, default 2). With high latency between the gateway and controller or EDA, tokens can expire in flight and give 401 errors. Raise the buffer in **Settings > Platform gateway > Edit platform gateway settings**.
